features.name: home_ownership_score
features.description: Normalized ratio of home owners to total housing tenure (owners vs renters), capturing propensity for property ownership which correlates with mobile home interest
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear separator for property ownership orientation, directly relevant to mobile home policy likelihood

features.name: total_policy_count
features.description: Sum of all insurance policy counts across all policy types, representing overall insurance engagement breadth
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous measure of insurance portfolio size useful as linear feature for engagement level
features.formula: numberOfPrivateThirdPartyInsurance + numberOfThirdPartyInsuranceFirms + numberOfThirdPartyInsuranceAgriculture + numberOfCarPolicies + numberOfDeliveryVanPolicies + numberOfMotorcycleScooterPolicies + numberOfLorryPolicies + numberOfTrailerPolicies + numberOfTractorPolicies + numberOfAgriculturalMachinesPolicies + numberOfMopedPolicies + numberOfLifeInsurances + numberOfPrivateAccidentInsurancePolicies + numberOfFamilyAccidentsInsurancePolicies + numberOfDisabilityInsurancePolicies + numberOfFirePolicies + numberOfBoatPolicies + numberOfBicyclePolicies + numberOfPropertyInsurancePolicies + numberOfSocialSecurityInsurancePolicies

features.name: agricultural_policy_index
features.description: Composite score of agricultural and rural insurance policies (tractor, agriculture machines, third party agriculture), indicating rural/farming lifestyle
features.expected_model_benefit: Rural lifestyle indicator that may correlate with mobile home ownership patterns

features.name: income_weighted_score
features.description: Weighted income score using income bracket proportions with higher weights for lower income brackets, normalized to 0-1 range
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth continuous income proxy useful for linear margin separation

features.name: household_size_age_interaction
features.description: Interaction between average household size and age midpoint (mapped from categorical age), capturing family life stage
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures family life stage combinations relevant to housing decisions, useful as linear feature

features.name: fire_policy_engagement
features.description: Log-transformed fire policy contribution score, capturing property insurance engagement with diminishing returns
features.expected_model_benefit: Property insurance engagement signal with smooth log scaling suitable for linear SVM

features.name: lower_class_family_score
features.description: Semantic score (0-1) reflecting likelihood of lower-income large family profile based on customerSubtype and customerMainType combinations. Higher scores for lower class large families, low income catholics, and average families with lower education.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures demographic segment most likely to consider mobile homes as affordable housing option

features.name: rural_lifestyle_indicator
features.description: Semantic score (0-1) for rural/agricultural lifestyle based on customerMainType (Farmers highest), customerSubtype, and presence of agricultural features. Farmers=1.0, rural subtypes=0.7, suburban=0.3, urban=0.0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Rural lifestyle strongly associated with mobile home ownership; provides semantic signal beyond formula features

features.name: education_lower_ratio
features.description: Proportion of lower education level relative to total education distribution, indicating lower educational attainment in the area
features.expected_model_benefit: Education level proxy as smooth ratio feature for linear SVM margin

features.name: car_ownership_intensity
features.description: Weighted car ownership score combining one-car and two-car proportions, normalized to capture vehicle ownership level
features.expected_model_benefit: Vehicle ownership pattern as continuous feature; mobile home owners often have specific car ownership patterns

features.name: social_class_lower_score
features.description: Weighted composite of lower social classes (C and D) relative to higher classes (A and B1), capturing socioeconomic positioning
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth socioeconomic gradient feature for linear SVM; lower social class may correlate with mobile home preference

features.name: multi_policy_breadth_score
features.description: Count of distinct policy types held (binary indicator per type summed), measuring insurance portfolio diversification
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized breadth of insurance engagement as continuous linear feature; diverse policy holders may have different risk profiles
